items.title: Toronto crime tips org freezes operations after details of data breach come to light
items.summary: Late Wednesday night the Toronto chapter of Crime Stoppers broke ranks with the national association, revealing a timeline showing what it knew and when along with an announcement that it will pause operations.

items.title: Indian tech company eMudhra announces withdrawal from certificate business after security incident
items.summary: The issue was publicized by cybersecurity researcher Scott Helme, who published a blog saying that instead of a random 384-bit number, one of the company's private keys was just the number four.

items.title: Microsoft blames ConnectWise attacks on Chinese state hacker using ARTEX AI agents
items.summary: A Chinese government-aligned hacking group used automated tools to carry out the recent supply chain attack on IT management software company ConnectWise and is using the same techniques to try to compromise organizations around the globe, Microsoft said.

items.title: Cybercrime crackdown across Africa leads to 1,462 arrests, $105 million seized
items.summary: More than 1,400 suspected cybercriminals were arrested across Africa this summer as part of a crackdown on the gangs perpetrating online fraud, ransomware and business email compromise attacks, Interpol said.

items.title: South Carolina officials offer assistance after state capital hit with cyberattack
items.summary: The systems impacted by the attack include the MyColaSC platform that citizens use to pay utility bills, report non-emergency issues and access other city services.
